description: Neutral, cited explainer for ONE ballot measure. Present both sides from the official voter guide. Never recommend a vote.

measure_id.description: Measure letter or proposition number exactly as on the ballot, e.g. 'Measure T' or 'Proposition 1'.

jurisdiction.description: Who placed it on the ballot / where it applies, e.g. 'City of Walnut Creek'.

ballot_question.description: The ballot question, quoted verbatim from the official sample ballot or voter guide.

plain_language_summary.description: 2-3 neutral sentences on what the measure would change, based on the impartial analysis (city attorney / county counsel / Legislative Analyst).

yes_means.description: One sentence: what happens if it passes. Paraphrase the impartial analysis.

no_means.description: One sentence: what happens if it fails. Paraphrase the impartial analysis.

vote_threshold.description: Votes needed to pass, e.g. 'simple majority' or 'two-thirds'. Null if not stated.

fiscal_impact.description: Cost, tax, or savings impact per the official fiscal analysis. Null if none was published.

argument_for.description: The official ballot argument IN FAVOR, attributed to its signers.

status.description: 'filed' if an argument in favor appears in the official voter guide; 'none_filed' if the guide states none was filed; 'not_found' if you could not locate the voter guide text.

summary.description: Neutral 2-3 sentence summary of the argument's main points, framed as 'Supporters say ...'. Null unless status is 'filed'.

signers.description: Names/titles of signers as printed. Empty if none.

argument_against.description: The official ballot argument AGAINST, attributed to its signers.

status.description: 'filed' if an argument against appears in the official voter guide; 'none_filed' if the guide states none was filed; 'not_found' if you could not locate the voter guide text.

summary.description: Neutral 2-3 sentence summary of the argument's main points, framed as 'Opponents say ...'. Null unless status is 'filed'.

signers.description: Names/titles of signers as printed. Empty if none.

official_source_url.description: URL of the official county/state page with the full measure text, impartial analysis, and arguments.
